topic: Quality assurance in Indian Navy, station / Carrier / yard QA cell – organisation, manpower, duties and responsibilities.
syllabus_extract: Quality assurance in Indian Navy, station / Carrier / yard QA cell – organisation, manpower, duties and responsibilities.
specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the concept of quality assurance, control and indigenization.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of QA Cell organizational chart and duty roster; Instructor supervision required for verification of roles.
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between quality assurance and quality control?
Define the term 'indigenization' in the context of naval stores.
Why is QA essential for maintaining airworthiness in the Indian Navy?

topics: Role of QA in Indian Navy
Station and Carrier QA Cell Structure

Concept of Quality Assurance
Quality Control vs Quality Assurance
Role of QA in Indian Navy
Station and Carrier QA Cell Structure

Duties of QA Officer
Responsibilities of QA Inspectors
QA Cell functions in Yard
Reporting mechanisms

QA Cell functions in Carrier

summary_questions: List three key duties of a QA Officer in a naval station.
Explain how the QA Cell ensures the airworthiness of indigenized stores.
Describe the reporting chain for a non-conformance found during inspection.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the role of QA in the indigenization of flight-critical stores, referencing the agencies associated with the process (to be covered in LP 07).

pft_rows.syllabus: Indigenisation of air stores, flight critical and non-flight critical stores, airworthiness of indigenized stores, agencies associated with Indigenisation, Indigenisation process
